4 أَفْرَهَت She (a camel) brought forth [young ones such as are termed] فُرْهٌ (S) or فُرَّهٌ (K) [i. e. such as were brisk, lively, sprightly, active, agile, or light]; as also ↓ فرّهت , inf. n. تَفْرِيهٌ. (K.) ―
-b2- And She (a woman) brought forth beautiful children. (TA.) ―
-b3- And افره He (a man) took for himself a غُلَام [i. e. youth, young man, or male slave,] such as is termed فَارِهٌ (IAar, K) meaning beautiful, or comely, of countenance. (IAar, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
